basic_profile.bio: An avid gamer and recovering alcoholic from Toowoomba, Australia. I spend my evenings exploring virtual worlds like Valheim and Idle Apocalypse. Recently, I've been focusing on self-improvement and sobriety, often seeking support on forums like Alcoholics Anonymous. By day, I work as a freelance graphic designer, which allows me the flexibility to attend meetings and take time for self-care. I'm single and currently focused on personal growth. My usual online hours are late afternoon to midnight, given my work-from-home lifestyle and timezone.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in digital arts, having pursued a diploma in graphic design. My love for video games has led me to self-teach game design principles, which I often discuss in subreddits. My journey to sobriety has also made me knowledgeable about addiction recovery processes, largely through personal experience and interaction with recovery communities.
